title: Fix Missing Sketchpad Export and App Configs
description: The compose/sketchpad/index.tsx file is missing the exported Sketchpad component, appRegistry instance, and app config objects (homeConfig, designConfig, kitConfig, typeConfig, qualityConfig, docsConfig, feedbackConfig) that consumers (play, vscode, desktop, docs sites) import from @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad. This causes a runtime SyntaxError: "does not provide an export named 'Sketchpad'".
